fact: As updated on 29 June 2026, the WAMU Banking Commission lists Burkina Faso with one licensed e-money institution (Orange Money Burkina Faso, EME.BF.011/2016) and two payment institutions (Intouch Burkina, Kerry Payments Burkina, registered 2025).
title: Liste des établissements de paiement et de monnaie électronique - Burkina
